title: Shannon C NDE 6613
content: I don't remember how I got there, but I ended up in a room that was like a waiting room. I saw many of my family and friends who had passed over, but they all had their backs turned to me. Everyone but my husband's grandmother (I later learned that she had passed away the same day I did). She and I were trying to figure out what was going on. I could not talk to anyone but her. She could talk to everyone though. I was heartbroken, especially because I could not talk to my oldest son, who was fourteen. A door opened, the kind of door that elevators have. I saw a glimpse of Heaven. This was the Garden of Eden, the way God intended it to be. It was too beautiful for words. I had that feeling you get when you see something truly amazing, breathtakingly beautiful. I miss it. Anyway, there was a figure who came from one of the mountains. He glowed like white golden light, very warm and peaceful. When he got closer, I knew he was Jesus. He still had holes in his hands. He told me I still had a job to do. Then I felt like I was stuck in some kind of vacuum. That's when there was a very bright flashing light. I hated that light. It hurts just thinking about it now. That's all I can remember so far.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Felt "stuck in some kind of vacuum."

arrival.religious_figure_detail: Identified the glowing figure as Jesus; he "glowed like white golden light" and "still had holes in his hands."

environment.environment_other_detail: A "waiting room"; a door like an elevator door opened showing a glimpse of Heaven described as "the Garden of Eden" with mountains; "too beautiful for words."

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Jesus told her she "still had a job to do."

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Waiting-room setting; elevator-like door opening; "stuck in some kind of vacuum" followed by a "very bright flashing light" that she hated and found painful.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Entered a waiting-room environment with deceased people first; then saw a glimpse of Heaven through an elevator-like door; then encountered Jesus; then experienced a vacuum-like state and a painful flashing light.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Deceased relatives/friends had their backs turned; only husband's grandmother interacted with her (and had died the same day). Elevator-like door opened to a glimpse of Heaven described as the Garden of Eden. After Jesus' message, she felt stuck in a vacuum and experienced a painful bright flashing light.

"He glowed like white golden light, very warm and peaceful." "I knew he was Jesus. He still had holes in his hands." "He told me I still had a job to do." "I felt like I was stuck in some kind of vacuum." "There was a very bright flashing light. I hated that light."
